title: Italian classes in Atlanta, with a native Italian
metaDescription: Italian lessons in Atlanta for adults with Valentina, a native Italian. One to one or small groups, in person or online. You speak from the first lesson.
intro: Italian lessons for adults in Atlanta, one to one or in a small group, in person or online. Taught by Valentina, who grew up in Italy and teaches the way she learned languages herself: by speaking.
heroImageAlt: A cafe table in an Italian piazza

sections.heading: Who these lessons are for
sections.body:
People with Italian family who want to talk with their relatives. People planning a trip, or a longer stay. People who simply love the language, the food and the films, and want to understand them without subtitles.

Complete beginners are welcome. So are people who studied Italian years ago and want it back.

sections.heading: What a lesson looks like
sections.body:
You speak from the first lesson, with real situations: ordering, introducing yourself, telling a story about your week. Grammar comes in when you need it. Between lessons you get short, practical things to do, never a pile of homework.

[EXAMPLE] In person we meet at your home or at a place in Atlanta that works for both of us. Online, the lesson is the same, on video.

faq.a: [EXAMPLE] Yes, from complete beginner to advanced conversation.

faq.q: Can I do a mix of in person and online?
faq.a: [EXAMPLE] Yes. In person when you can, online on busy weeks.

faq.q: How long until I can hold a conversation?
faq.a: It depends on how much you practice between lessons, and we keep that light and realistic. You speak from the first lesson, so you notice progress early.

faq.q: Do you prepare people for exams or certificates?
faq.a: [EXAMPLE] Yes, ask about it in your inquiry and we plan the lessons around the exam.
